explanation.what_it_is: The Code Execution Tool v2 allows executing Bash commands and directly manipulating files, in addition to writing code in multiple languages.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update enables Claude Code users to automate more complex workflows and interact with the file system, going beyond Python-only execution.
